messages.message:
Patch Set 1:

(4 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good, only style comments inline. The folio conversion itself looks correct: filemap_lock_folio() returns ERR_PTR(-ENOENT) on newer kernels and NULL on older ones plus the find_lock_page() shim, and IS_ERR_OR_NULL() covers both. Dropping the find_or_create_page() allocation also looks right, and is a bonus on the osd_object_delete()->osd_drop_preallocated_space() path which can run under PF_MEMALLOC/PF_KSWAPD.

parents.subject: LU-17916 clio: switch to struct folio of order 0

commit.subject: LU-17916 osd-ldiskfs: prefer jbd2_journal_invalidate_folio()
commit.message:
LU-17916 osd-ldiskfs: prefer jbd2_journal_invalidate_folio()

Use folio API to interact with jbd2 in kernels which support
struct folio.

This also drops folio alloc when getting cache pages, since
there is nothing to truncate when the folio is not in the
system cache.

Signed-off-by: Shaun Tancheff <shaun@tancheff.com>
Change-Id: Iae187e3acbf2ebf3a2b99768d09916928c5c62ce
